front.title: Binding Attestation to Forward TLS Connections

abstract.t:
This document specifies a mechanism that allows a Relying Party to perform post-handshake remote attestation of a peer over a dedicated TLS connection and binds the resulting Attestation Credential to subsequent, fresh TLS connections to the same attested Target Environment, including connections to different server endpoints hosted within it.
Forward Attested TLS decouples _when trust is established_ from _when trust is exercised_.
